servinfo.title: Fuel Low-Pressure Basic Check
servinfo.ptxt: Before performing the following procedure, observe Precautions for Fuel System Service:K14C .

s1.ptxt: Relieve fuel pressure from fuel feed line.
Remove high pressure fuel pump cover.
Disconnect fuel feed hose from high pressure fuel pump.
Connect special tools and hose between fuel feed hose (1) and high pressure fuel pump (2) as shown in figure, and clamp hoses securely to check that no leakage occurs during check.
Check that battery voltage is 11 V or more.
If measured pressure is out of specification, refer to Low-Pressure Fuel Supply Circuit Check:K14C and check each possible defective part. Replace if found defective.

s2.ptxt: Set ignition “ON” to operate fuel pump and turn it “OFF” after 2 seconds. Repeat this 3 or 4 times and then check fuel pressure.

s1.ptxt: Remove special tools from high pressure fuel pump and fuel feed hose.
Connect fuel feed hose to high pressure fuel pump and clamp it securely.
With engine stopped, set ignition “ON” and check for fuel leakage.
Install high pressure fuel pump cover.
